description: This file contains benchmarking code for sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV) using different sparse matrix formats (CSR and COO). It defines functions to generate sparse matrices, perform timing tests, and outputs performance metrics based on command-line arguments.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A utility class for timing events, with methods to record timestamps and compute elapsed time.

methods.name: test_sparse_csr
methods.description: Performs timing tests on sparse CSR matrix multiplication.

methods.name: test_sparse_coo
methods.description: Performs timing tests on sparse COO matrix multiplication.

methods.name: test_sparse_coo_and_csr
methods.description: Performs timing tests on both COO and CSR sparse matrix multiplications and returns their average times.
